description: Department of Labour - The Cost of Living Index Number for the month of October, 2015 applicable to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper growing and manufacturing trade is 182.1 and the Special Allowance payable November, 2015 will be Rs. 565.01
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns the declaration of the Cost of Living Index Number and the calculation of a special allowance for workers, which is done under the authority of the Wages Boards Ordinance. The core content is a regulatory action—publishing a statutory instrument (a notification) that determines a legally binding rate for worker allowances based on a prescribed formula. This fits the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5), which includes "Statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation" and "Regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements." While a government official is named, the notice is about implementing a regulation, not about the official's appointment, portfolio, or a change in government structure. Therefore, the specialized legal/regulatory classification takes precedence.
